title: Balance & Bite's Thai Beef Salad
ingredients: Protein & Base: 300g scotch fillet steak, 100g cooked vermicelli noodles, 1/2 cup white rice
Greens & Produce: 1 cos lettuce, 2 punnet cherry tomatoes, 1/2 bunch Thai basil, Vietnamese mint & coriander
Dressing: 1/4 cup fish sauce, 2 limes juiced, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 clove garlic, 2 green chillies
Pantry: 1 tbsp olive oil, salt & pepper
steps: Toast rice in a frypan over medium-high heat for 3-5 mins until golden, then grind into a coarse powder.
Season steak with salt, pepper and olive oil, then sear in a hot pan for 2-3 mins per side and rest.
Grind garlic and chillies into a paste, then mix with lime juice, fish sauce and sugar to form dressing.
Toss lettuce, noodles, tomatoes and herbs in a large dish, then top with thinly sliced rested steak.
Drizzle with dressing, scatter with toasted rice powder, and serve with extra chilli and lime.
